title: fix(rest)!: refuse unknown keys on the dataset query body (#29156)

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9V3vR51WpJqhGrbpzMAviUT)_
Fixes #29156

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集查询接口 `POST /analytics/dataset/query` 现在拒收请求体里它不认识的键(400 VALIDATION_FAILED,点名该键);把 `runtimeFilter` 放错在 `selection` 外面时，提示「did you mean `selection.runtimeFilter`」。同时给了 `dataset` 又给 `datasetName` 也拒收。
- 为什么改：以前放错位置的筛选条件被静默丢掉，接口照样 200,返回的是未筛选的总数，看板数字偏大且无人察觉。
- 风险与回滚：只影响发送了多余键的调用方;客户端 SDK、控制台看板/报表/数据集预览、verify 都只发这四个键，实测不受影响。回滚即还原 `analytics-routes.ts` 的一处调用。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-body-door.ts`(判定逻辑与提示);`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`(接入点，在 selection 判定之前);`packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-body-door.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-dataset-body-door.test.ts`,预期 19 条全过(其中 10 条在 main 上为红)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST {basePath}/analytics/dataset/query` judged `body.selection` (through `datasetSelectionRefusal`), `body.dataset` and `body.datasetName`, and ignored every other top-level key. A `runtimeFilter` written beside `selection` instead of inside it answered **200 with the unfiltered aggregate**; `"bogus": 1` beside `selection` answered 200 too. The sibling door `POST /analytics/query` refuses an unknown key, and this door's own `selection` refuses one with a "did you mean" hint.

- New `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-body-door.ts`: `datasetQueryBodyRefusal(body)` over the closed set `DATASET_QUERY_BODY_KEYS` = `dataset`, `datasetName`, `previewDrafts`, `selection`, measured from the handler's read points (the handler reads exactly these four off `req.body`).
  - An unknown key answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, message `Unrecognized key(s) on this dataset query: ...` (the sibling door's opening), one `details.fields[]` entry per key with `code: unknown_field`. The query never runs.
  - Remedy: `runtimeFilter`, `filter`, `filters`, `where` say `did you mean selection.runtimeFilter?`; any other selection member says `did you mean selection.KEY?`. The member list is read off `DatasetSelectionSchema.shape`, not transcribed.
  - A truthy `dataset` beside a truthy `datasetName` (the handler's own truthiness) answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming both (`invalid_shape`). A falsy `datasetName` beside `dataset` still runs inline, and a falsy `dataset` beside a name still runs the saved dataset, as before.
- `analytics-routes.ts`: one call, right after the body is read and before the `selection.measures` check, so a misplaced member is named before "selection.measures must be a non-empty array".
- Envelope: this door's own body-refusal frame (flat `{ code, message, details.fields }`, the one an unknown `selection` key already answers here), not the nested `{ error: {...} }` the sibling dispatcher door writes. One door, one dialect.
- Changeset `.changeset/29156-dataset-query-body-unknown-keys.md` (`@objectstack/rest` patch, BREAKING banner, Before / Now / Unchanged bullets and the remedy, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).
- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` states the body shape, so it now says which keys the body takes and what is refused.

No `packages/spec` or `ui/` edit.

## Why

A dropped filter is a wider number with nothing to tell it apart from a filter that matched everything: the REST ingress policy's silent-widening case (`query-allowlist.ts`), on the body instead of the query string.

### Producer census (before narrowing)

| Producer | Keys it sends |
|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/client` `analytics.queryDataset` | the caller's payload, typed `dataset?`, `datasetName?`, `selection`, `previewDrafts?` |
| Console `ui/packages/data-objectstack` `queryDataset` (dashboards, reports, charts, filter bar, dataset preview) | `datasetName` OR `dataset` (a ternary), `selection`, `previewDrafts` only when true |
| `@objectstack/verify` `dashboard-window.ts` | `datasetName`, `selection` |
| docs `analytics.mdx`, platform-checklist `dashboards.json` / `studio-authoring.json` | `datasetName`, `selection` |
| dogfood suites (10 files) | `dataset` or `datasetName`, `selection` |
| MCP / AI tools (`packages/mcp`, `service-ai`) | none: no caller of this door |

No producer sends a key outside the four, and none sends both `dataset` and `datasetName`, so the pair is refused in this PR (delta acceptance 3).

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-body-door.test.ts` (new, 19 cases, through the real route): §1 refusals (top-level `runtimeFilter` on a saved and an inline dataset, `filter` / `filters` / `where`, a misplaced `dimensions`, `bogus`, several keys sorted, the accepted keys listed), each asserting status, `code`, the named keys, the remedy, and that `queryDataset` was never called; §2 the `dataset` + `datasetName` refusal (no lookup, no query) and its three controls (a `''` and a `null` `datasetName` beside `dataset` run inline; a `null` `dataset` beside a name runs the saved dataset); §3 controls asserting the arguments the service received (`datasetName`, inline `dataset`, `selection.runtimeFilter`, `previewDrafts`, the unchanged selection-level refusal, the unchanged "Provide body.dataset" message).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/analytics-dataset-body-door.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 4 cases, showcase stack over HTTP): plain body 200 with a count above 0; `selection.runtimeFilter` 200 and narrows to 0; top-level `runtimeFilter` 400 with the remedy; `bogus` 400.
- No existing test needed an edit.

- Out of scope, noted: the same route's query string is not a closed set (it reads `preview` through `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` only); the ingress policy converts routes per lane.
